title: BPSec support (RFC 9171 s8, RFC 9172/9173) as a conformance item under the DTN thread
detail: RFC 9171 s8 places bundle security in BPSec (RFC 9172; default security contexts RFC 9173: BIB-HMAC-SHA2, BCB-AES-GCM). Present: receiver-side primitive I/O in host/native/bpsec-crypto.lisp (HMAC and the authentication-only AES-GCM first pass, inside HST-004's trust boundary; it does not admit bundles or install the decryption second pass) and the ASB parsing books (books/bpsec-asb-*.lisp). Absent: a conformance statement of what fn accepts, verifies, refuses and forwards per block type and context; the ACL2 decision wiring from ASB parse to primitive to admission; the BCB decryption pass; the source and verifier roles (fn only receives); interop fixtures against an independent BPSec implementation. Gate when started: a conformance matrix (RFC 9172 s5-s9 rows, RFC 9173 contexts 1-2) with each row's keystone or native test. Not started.
notes: 2026-10-08 (N, filing for the coordinator): deferred, not started; un-parks when the coordinator staffs the DTN thread (DTN depth is one of ember's open mandate threads).
